[SWS_CM_11360] Execution Context for registering Getters
⌈
For the
RegisterGetHandler method described in [SWS_CM_00114] a second overload
with an additional input parameter shall be provided. This parameter shall provide an
executioner object in which RegisterGetHandler shall be invoked. The minimum
behaviour of the Execution Context is defined in [SWS_CM_11364].
template<typename ExecutorT>
ara::core::Result<void> RegisterGetHandler(
std::function<ara::core::Future<FieldType>(
)> getHandler, ExecutorT&& executor);
For the first overload without an execution context argument an implementation de-
fined default execution context (like in previous AUTOSAR releases) shall be used.
⌋

⌈
For the
RegisterGetHandler method described in [SWS_CM_00114] a second overload
with an additional input parameter shall be provided. This parameter shall provide an executioner object in which any asynchronous computation spawn by Register-
GetHandler shall be invoked. The minimum behavior of the Execution Context is
defined in [SWS_CM_11364].
template<typename ExecutorT>
ara::core::Result<void> RegisterGetHandler(
std::function<ara::core::Future<FieldType>(
)> getHandler, ExecutorT&& executor);
For the first overload without an execution context argument an implementation defined
default execution context (like in previous AUTOSAR releases) shall be used. In case
RegisterGetHandler fails, ComErrc::kSetHandlerFailure shall be returned
in the Result.
